name: chippy
title: Chippy
description: A fish-and-chip shop theme whose menu is the peg-letter board above the fryer: white push-in capitals on grooved black felt, section names and prices in chip yellow down the right, hung beside plain pages of chip-paper white and black ink.

tokens.--font-display: the board's letters, the site title, headings, labels and the order button — plain grotesque capitals
tokens.--font-body: body text and the small print under each name on the board
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--text-peg: size of the letters on the board: names, prices and section names
tokens.--tracking-peg: the wide letter spacing of the board's capitals, the site title, the menu links and the order button
tokens.--tracking-label: the narrower letter spacing of headings and small capital labels in page text
tokens.--color-bg: page background (chip paper by day, the shop with the lights down at night)
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, and the heavy rules under the masthead and over the footer
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: hours labels, dates, the footer
tokens.--color-accent: links in page text and focus rings (black ink by day, chip yellow at night)
tokens.--color-border: thin dividing lines: between hours, between posts, in tables
tokens.--color-felt: the board's black felt: the board, the strip behind the menu links, the skip link, and the order button under the pointer
tokens.--color-groove: the fine horizontal grooves ruled across the felt
tokens.--color-peg: the white letters on the board: names of the things sold
tokens.--color-peg-dim: the small print on the board: descriptions under each name
tokens.--color-chip: chip yellow: section names and prices on the board, the order button, the highlight behind a link under the pointer
tokens.--color-chip-ink: text on chip yellow: the order button and highlighted links
tokens.--color-frame: the aluminium frame round the board
tokens.--shadow-board: the shadow the board casts on the wall behind it
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of page text
tokens.--page-width: maximum width of the masthead, the footer and the home page
tokens.--board-width: maximum width of the board on the menu page and on single item pages
tokens.--groove: distance from one groove of the board to the next; every row of letters is a whole number of grooves tall
tokens.--price-col: width of the price column down the right of the board, which names keep clear of; a longer price reaches left of it or drops to the row below
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the board, the order button, code and images
tokens.--rule: weight of the heavy rules and of focus rings
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: between small labels, under the footer's lines
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside hours rows, around menu links, between a name and its price
tokens.--space-3: gap between paragraphs and between the rows of a post list
tokens.--space-4: gap between blocks, and above headings
tokens.--space-5: large gap: between the home page's text and the board, and below the page
